capabilities: call large language models from Templater templates with tp.ai.chat
connect to OpenAI or any LLM that supports the OpenAI API
extras: Detailed usage instructions are hosted elsewhere rather than in the README. The README warns that the plugin makes internet requests to the OpenAI API unless configured to use a local LLM, and that an OpenAI API key is required.
intentEvidence: This plugin extends Templater to interact with large language models.
problem: Templater has no built-in way to call large language models from within templates, so users cannot generate or transform text with an LLM during templating.

relations.evidence: This plugin extends Templater to interact with large language models.

summary: Extends the Templater plugin with AI commands, adding a tp.ai.chat function that sends prompts to OpenAI-compatible large language models.
